description.value: Eagle Lodge is part of the Town Plaza Suites complex in Whistler Village North, offering studio, one- and two-bedroom condos with fully equipped kitchens, gas fireplaces, and in-suite washer/dryers. It sits a short walk from both mountain gondolas and the Whistler Conference Centre, making it a convenient self-catering base for cyclists exploring the Sea to Sky corridor. The surrounding Village North puts restaurants, shops, and nightlife immediately at hand.
